title: Hull document
description: An authored HULL (server/shipclasses/*.json, schema 3): its multi-deck plan kept as raw text rows (deck-plan format v3, docs/deckplan-format.md), the slots modules overlay, the mounts parts hang on, its dry mass, its capability tags and the loadout it ships with (docs/modules.md). Derived from the Gleam decoders in server/src/dh_server/hull.gleam (hull_decoder/cargo_decoder/default_loadout_decoder/tags_decoder) — those decoders are the source of truth; this schema is documentation and a typo-catcher, not a substitute for them. A hull is NOT a resolved ship class: shipclass.gleam decodes the wire form loadout.resolve bakes out of a hull, which carries a required flight block a hull document must never have. additionalProperties is false at every object level even though the decoders themselves ignore unknown fields, precisely so this schema can catch typos the decoders would silently swallow.

consoles.description: Optional. Derived at load from the grids: h/c/b (helm/cargo/broker) are wall-mounted edge fixtures on the floor tile they face, Q (docking port) is a center glyph; the server re-emits this list (namespaced, over the wire) but hand-authored docs omit it.

capacity.description: Hold size in cargo units. Must be >= 0 (enforced by the Gleam decoder's validate step, not by this schema).

handling.description: How cargo physically gets aboard: break-bulk hulls load by robot stevedores anywhere; container hulls need a station crane and never open their holds.

dock_port_orientation.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 90). This hull's docking-port outward normal in its own frame, in DEGREES (0 = nose/+x). 90 = port flank (side-on mooring, the default). Combined with a station berth's orientation to fix the moored heading (issue #14).

dock_standoff.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 20.0). How far this hull's centre stands off the berth mooring line, in tiles (= metres), along the berth's outward normal — the per-ship half of the moored sim pose (issue #31). Authored per class since wide hulls stand off further than narrow ones.

mass.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 100.0; server/src/dh_server/hull.gleam). Dry structural mass — total fit mass = this + every fitted module and part (docs/modules.md, M4).

mounts.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default []). Exterior attach points parts hang on (docs/modules.md, M4).

slots.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default []). Modulable interior regions (docs/modules.md, M4). A tile joins a slot by carrying that slot's hex digit in its SW corner; everything without a digit is fixed hull structure no module may overwrite.

default_loadout.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field). The loadout this hull ships with: slot id -> module id, mount id -> part id.

grid.description: 3*height rows of 3*width chars: each tile is a 3x3 block. Centre glyph = ' ' floor, '.' void, 'x' stairs, 's' spawn, or 'Q' docking port — spawn/docking are DERIVED from these glyphs. N/E/S/W edge-mids = ' ' open, '#' wall, '=' door, letter fixture — h=helm, c=cargo, b=broker are wall-mounted console fixtures, DERIVED into the consoles list the same way. See docs/deckplan-format.md. Row count and each row's length must be multiples of 3 and consistent (enforced by the Gleam decoder, not by this schema).

kind.description: Free-form in the decoder (e.g. "helm"/"cargo" are conventions, not constraints); left open here. At least one console of kind "helm" is required by the Gleam decoder's validate step, not by this schema.

deck.description: Which deck index this console sits on (default 0).
Which deck arriving characters appear on (default 0).

tile.description: [x, y] tile where arriving characters appear (the airlock/gangway end).

tags.description: A {tag: amount} object. Tags are open strings the engine only compares and sums (server/src/dh_server/hull.gleam tags_decoder).

slot.description: One modulable interior region. Both `digit` and `id` must be unique across a hull's slots — enforced by hull.validate, not by this schema: JSON Schema draft-06 has no way to say "this property is unique across the items of an array".

digit.description: The hex digit hull tiles carry in their SW corner to join this slot (range enforced by the Gleam decoder's validate step too).

id.description: What a module names in its own "slot" field.

kind.description: What sort of part takes this mount — "engine" for now.

size.description: A mount takes any part of its kind up to this size.
